effects: WANTED: DEAD: Once per this activation: Apply +1 Damage or +1 Surge to the attack results.
SAVAGE MOTIVATION: If at any point during this activation a Rebel figure is adjacent to this group, roll 1 yellow die — that figure suffers that much Damage. {W} figures roll 1 blue die instead.

VENDETTA: Once per this activation: Reroll 1 attack die — choose a red die showing only 1 {H} result, a blue or green die showing no {H} results, or a yellow die showing only the single {B}.
The attack gains: {B}: Reroll 1 additional attack die using the same criteria. Only spend if no other surge abilities remain.
NOWHERE TO HIDE: Once per this activation: Figures do not block line of sight for this attack and you add 1 blue die to the attack pool.
